FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 207
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Josh Carnley
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/19/2025
Senate Bill 207 as introduced could increase receipts to the Agricultural Fund by an estimated
$7,000 annually, if cotton producers vote to increase the levy assessed on cotton sales in the
state from $1 per bale, under current law, to $1.30 per bale, as provided by this bill.
